name: session_update
description: Update an existing session's metadata when you need to rename a session, reassign its agent, change its parent session, or change its status. The tool mutates only session metadata and returns the updated session plus changed fields; if requested values already match current values, no mutation occurs. The target session, target agent, and target parent session must exist; use session inspection/search tools for reading messages or finding session IDs.

session_id.description: ID of the session to update

agent_id.description: New agent ID to assign to the session

parent_session_id.description: New parent session ID to set as the session's parent
